To calculate \(17 \times 23\), you can use the standard multiplication method:

\[
\begin{array}{r}
\quad 17 \\
\times 23 \\
\hline
\quad 51 \quad \text{(17 × 3)} \\
+ 340 \quad \text{(17 × 20)} \\
\hline
391 \\
\end{array}
\]

So, \(17 \times 23 = 391\).

\[

\quad 17 \\
\times 23 \\
\hline
\quad 51 \quad \text{(17 × 3)} \\
+ 340 \quad \text{(17 × 20)} \\
\hline
391 \\
\end{array}
\]

So, \(17 \times 23 = 391\).
